title: Encoded action payload
statement: For each natural number $k$ and each Boolean string of length $4k+4$, form the code-read action for that string followed by a false bit, extract its action component, and use the default action if no action is returned. The resulting action is for a machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and a singleton state set.
hypotheses_covered: The input is a Boolean string of length $4k+4$
caveat: The code-reading procedure used to construct the action is referenced but not defined in the supplied material, so its exact mathematical meaning cannot be stated independently.
